student_question: Which runs train the method and which runs test it?
pass_evidence: Disjoint frozen run sets with hashes and complete counts
stop_condition: Overlap missing run or unexplained exclusion

student_question: Does every event have the independently authorized frame width?
pass_evidence: One source-bound width and zero malformed events
stop_condition: Any malformed event or shape chosen only because reshape succeeds

student_question: Do block boundaries coincide with physical channels?
pass_evidence: Pedestals and duplicate relationships align only in the authorized frame
stop_condition: Pulse-like steps appear at misframed boundaries

student_question: Are there localized physical pulses on the claimed channels?
pass_evidence: Stable rise/fall morphology on main and duplicate readout
stop_condition: Quiet channel or fixed structural step

student_question: Do duplicate readouts observe the same pulse?
pass_evidence: Stable signed gain and timing correlation
stop_condition: No correlation or pedestal-only correlation

student_question: Is the baseline uncontaminated and stable?
pass_evidence: Single stable population with small slope
stop_condition: Multiple modes drift or pulse in baseline window

student_question: Does the baseline change with acquisition time?
pass_evidence: Small calibrated drift with documented systematics
stop_condition: Abrupt jumps or unmodeled drift

student_question: Is the timed component the component that passes the cut?
pass_evidence: Diagonal or independently validated component class
stop_condition: Tiny early feature authorized by a later global peak

student_question: Does component selection follow one physical pulse family?
pass_evidence: Consistent sample relationship and duplicate match
stop_condition: Fixed early selector or component switching

student_question: Is the crossing on the intended rising edge?
pass_evidence: Positive bracket adequate slope and valid status
stop_condition: Window censoring recrossing wrong component or flat bracket

student_question: Where are physical events lost?
pass_evidence: All stages reconcile with named rejection reasons
stop_condition: Waveform rows called events or hidden population change

student_question: Are timestamps physically plausible?
pass_evidence: Interior continuous distributions without boundary piles
stop_condition: Boundary spikes or integer-sample lattice

student_question: Does a common particle time create the correlation?
pass_evidence: Stable diagonal relation across run and amplitude
stop_condition: Correlation only in one fixed sample cell

student_question: Is the narrow pair tied to a structural index?
pass_evidence: Broad physical occupancy with stable residual
stop_condition: One boundary/sample combination dominates

student_question: Which step moves the median and which changes width?
pass_evidence: Constant shifts move median only and event count stays fixed
stop_condition: Width changes after a constant correction

student_question: What population dominates?
pass_evidence: Central shape and population visible
stop_condition: Plot range hides events

student_question: Are there rare tails or satellite modes?
pass_evidence: Tail fractions quantified and modeled
stop_condition: Large hidden tails

student_question: Where does the approximately 0.1 ns central number come from?
pass_evidence: Q16 Q84 median and binning shown
stop_condition: Core shown without full distribution

student_question: Does the proposed model describe the data?
pass_evidence: Acceptable residuals and goodness metric
stop_condition: Huge chi2/ndf or systematic QQ departure

student_question: Was the fraction chosen without test-sample optimization?
pass_evidence: Frozen choice from calibration/validation and stable test result
stop_condition: Minimum selected and quoted on same events

student_question: Is amplitude-dependent timing removed?
pass_evidence: Held-out slope compatible with zero
stop_condition: Trend remains or same-sample correction

student_question: Does precision follow noise-over-slope expectations?
pass_evidence: Physically plausible improvement with slope/SNR
stop_condition: Ultra-narrow result independent of waveform quality

student_question: Is interpolation calibrated across sampling phase?
pass_evidence: No sawtooth bias or phase-localized width
stop_condition: Phase-dependent bias or one-bin narrow result

student_question: Is the result portable across independent data blocks?
pass_evidence: Compatible metrics with block/run intervals
stop_condition: One run dominates or strong drift

student_question: Is there enough connected information for stave inference?
pass_evidence: At least three connected physical pairs with common selection
stop_condition: One pair disconnected graph or pair-population mismatch

student_question: Can common trigger jitter be separated from stave jitter?
pass_evidence: External reference or validated hierarchical covariance model
stop_condition: Assumed zero covariance without evidence

student_question: Does the model reproduce all observed pairs?
pass_evidence: Non-negative solution and held-out pair closure
stop_condition: Negative/unphysical terms or poor closure

student_question: Does the complete analysis recover known truth?
pass_evidence: Bias and interval coverage close across a grid
stop_condition: Only one nominal point or failed coverage

student_question: How robust is the result to justified analysis choices?
pass_evidence: Complete propagated uncertainty budget
stop_condition: Only statistical uncertainty or undocumented tuning
